title: Penalty clause for contest.
bodyText: A provision in a will purporting to penalize an interested person for contesting the will or instituting other proceedings relating to the estate is unenforceable if probable cause exists for instituting proceedings.
bodyHtml: §560:2-517  Penalty clause for contest.  A provision in a will purporting to penalize an interested person for contesting the will or instituting other proceedings relating to the estate is unenforceable if probable cause exists for instituting proceedings. [L 1996, c 288, pt of §1]
